note: Primary images: 18 genuine transparent, full-shape color scientific illustrations downloaded unmodified from NOAA Fisheries. Every image was verified to have alpha=0 over a meaningful background area. These are source illustrations, not AI reconstructions or automatically removed photographic backgrounds. Photographs from the first asset pass are retained only in alternates for optional species-detail views. Scientific labels use the frozen project IUCN 2026-1 candidate list.
